svg.title: Applefall Orchard — Apple press terraces
svg.desc: Fruit walls climb to a cider press. Baskets and carts create short hops below a ladder-linked branch route; every grove has a visible escape stair. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops

svg.text: Fruit walls climb to a cider press. Baskets and carts create short hops below a ladder-
linked branch route; every grove has a visible escape stair.
7 raised landings · 2 stair flights · 3 rope climbs · 2 ladders · 20 placed props
R = same-map recovery · structural concept, not an exported collision mesh
P1 Brookbend Banks · P2 Old Bridge Road · P3 Boggle Basketwood
Encounter: Hedge Nibbler · Common; repeatable solo combat AND equivalent aid/repair objective.
